_comment: Curated directory for the austin.chat daily feed. tools/build_feed.py turns this into feed/feed.json. One block per topic: id (stable slug), lane (drives accent color + which pill shows it), label + icon (the card tag), priority (lower = earlier), and links[] (each title->headline, blurb->detail, url->link) that render as always-on cards. Optional fetch{type,enabled,...} points at a module in tools/feed_fetchers/ to replace the curated card with a live value; it falls back to the link on any error. Add a topic = add a block here (no code). Hand-pinned/ad cards go in feed_overrides.json.
